title: Land of Fire

The communities the film follows carry deep losses, visible in the burned forests and in the roadside posters of missing loved ones, many of them young women. Yet life here is shaped as much by resilience and solidarity as it is by grief.  Nikola Klinger has made a film about people facing complex challenges who nonetheless believe in a better future. By weaving together the interconnected lives of the locals, the film creates a layered portrait of the landscape and the people’s bond with the wilderness, its magic and its myths. Residents live in the shadow of unsolved deaths and the disappearances of young people, finding an escape from their troubles in community solidarity and modern-day rituals, such as the demolition derby at the local wreck yard.  “There is something alive out there in the bush; you can feel it, but you can’t see it.”

Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

title: Go for Gold
overview: A Filipina housekeeper starts her first day working for an injured Filipino-Canadian Track Star. In her attempt to connect with him culturally, secrets from his past in the Philippines unravel.

title: Hong Kong, Let's Get Married
overview: This documentary follows Hong Kong’s same-sex marriage movement through court challenges, activism, and personal stories as couples and advocates pursue recognition and equality.

title: Delineations
overview: "Delineations" is an experimental short film highlighting Long Island, New York. Made using satellite images from Google Earth, the film explores nostalgia, growth, and confinement.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Magpie
overview: Following the death of her mother, a young and talented pianist must find her way through monumental loss while preparing for an important audition. As grief and ambition begin to clash, Liz attempts to maintain a sense of normalcy while navigating the expectations from both herself and others. However, as she spirals through the stages of denial, anger, and devastation; she must come face-to-face with her loss and confront her grief through music.

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Creature of the Pines
overview: Creature of the Pines is a found footage horror movie set in the legendary New Jersey Pine Barrens, one of the most mysterious and unsettling stretches of wilderness in America. Locals have whispered about strange sightings and disappearances for generations, but few people are willing to talk about what they’ve seen, and even fewer dare to go looking.

title: Lorne
overview: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

title: Return from Tomorrow
overview: Randy Moore’s follow-up to the (in)famously filmed-in-secret Disney World fever-dream Escape from Tomorrow is an absurdist paranoid conspiracy thriller featuring the original cast in a completely new scenario. After the loss of his father, a middle-aged dad spirals into a Lynchian crisis of masculinity while on family vacation in Miami. As his inadequacies and unspoken desires drift him further away from his wife, he uncovers a mysterious plot involving his father, the gas company, cocaine, prostitution, and . . . Walt?

title: Me Time Is Not Long
overview: A trip up north for the funeral of my grandfather

title: Man-O-Wolf: The Axe Wielding Werewolf from Hell
original_title: Man-O-Wolf: The Axe Wielding Werewolf from Hell
overview: A werewolf slasher film created by prolific underground filmmaker Sam Hel.

title: Bare
overview: Late into the night, an anxious Kai invites a stranger over for a hook-up. He may be looking for connection, but is he ready for it?

title: House Rules
overview: HOUSE RULES is about a game night that spirals into bloody chaos as a group of friends unknowingly play a cursed board game. As the night unfolds, their darkest impulses emerge subconsciously, exposing the ruthless nature of game night and capitalism.

title: Everything Grows in Eden
overview: A young woman promises to take her suicidal best friend to an alternative retreat but when their volatile mutual friend joins the trip, an unexpected detour to a local commune forces all three to confront some painful truths.

title: Mystery Wrestling #24
overview: Mystery Wrestling #24 took place April 11 on Twitch.TV

title: Your Lips Never Left Mine
overview: A young woman is hired by a finance couple to tutor their son at their summer lake house, and finds herself increasingly enmeshed in the undisclosed darkness of their past.

title: You Can't Stop the Beet
overview: A comedic web series that follows the lives of three twenty-somethings in Los Angeles, who find themselves working at a beet-themed fast food restaurant despite their best efforts and lofty aspirations.

title: Stables
overview: Inspired by the real story of Ethan Stables, a young man who plotted a domestic terror attack on a Pride event in Barrow-in-Furness, Stables follows Seb the morning after a hook-up, waking up in a stranger's bed. But who really is the man that he is lying next to?

title: Egomaniacs
overview: His job interview at stake, Jerry, a reserved man, endures the waiting room with two egomaniacs.

title: Flytrapper
overview: Crystal’s life of extremely aggressive rap music, jet-skiing, and nefarious activities is upended by a visit from her estranged best friend, Melonie. With a motive in hand, Melonie begins digging into the past, what led to their falling out, and the connection it might share with the present. As the situation becomes increasingly unstable, she can’t help but stay as the two rekindle their friendship.

title: The School of Rocky
overview: A short film about a Rocky Horror Picture Show shadow cast and the Queer community built around it.

title: Myrna's Deal with the Dead
overview: In the seventh installment of this telenovela-style comedy series, Myrna is desperately searching for Baby Oscur, the missing heir to the family fortune—stolen by her arch-nemesis, Kittay. Out of options and at her wits’ end, Myrna seeks help from her longtime friend Dixie Longate, a psychic whose séances offer a hilariously unconventional path to the truth. A wild journey to Texas sets off a chain of unexpected revelations as Myrna uncovers not only the mystery of Baby Oscur’s whereabouts, but surprising truths about herself. Secrets unravel, loyalties shift, and—as always in Myrna’s chaotic world—another unfortunate soul ends up dead

title: You Used To Be Around
overview: When Rumi unexpectedly sees her ex-boyfriend, Nate, an unresolved confrontation spirals into a chilling revelation, forcing her to confront a truth far more terrifying than heartbreak.

title: Story Drive: Voices Unveiled
overview: Story Drive: Voices Unveiled is a hybrid-documentary that showcases real-life anonymous LGBTQIA+ voicemails and adapts them into a cinematic experience contrasting personal, raw, and at times emotional testimonies with otherworldly, whimsical, and experimental animation.

title: Doctor Death Grip
overview: An autofiction writer's viral essay about her six-fingered boyfriend's porn addiction tests a couple's already deteriorating relationship.

title: Bleeding Heart
overview: Shane, the last vampire on Earth, struggles to maintain the life he built for himself amongst his human peers as he hides behind his secret.
